title: RealTemp Roadmap
subtitle: Street-true perceived temperature · client-only web · Open-Meteo · PRD v2.0 2026-07-06
loop: Street-true temp → visible math → trust → daily habit → hyperlocal premium

cards.title: Run on Jason's iPhone + street check
cards.summary: Install via Xcode (npx cap open ios) or TestFlight; tap through search → dashboard in the shell; walk outside in Valencia and sanity-check True Feel.
cards.done: All PRD v0 checkboxes checked from a phone browser.

cards.title: Coefficient tuning from lived use
cards.summary: Adjust constants.ts after 2 weeks of Valencia street comparison; log deltas in DECISIONS.md.

cards.title: Paste Sentry DSN
cards.summary: Jason: sentry.io project → VITE_SENTRY_DSN in .env → rebuild. See docs/setup-remaining.md.

cards.title: Real name + domain
cards.summary: Research DONE (docs/naming.md): StreetFeel recommended, streetfeel.app available $9.99/yr, all candidates scanned for collisions. REMAINS: Jason picks, buys domain, formal EUIPO/USPTO clearance.

cards.title: Hyperlocal thermal heatmap (CV shadow-casting)
cards.summary: 3D building/canopy data → street-level shade map. Own data-sourcing project; flagship premium feature.

cards.title: Paywall + pricing (freemium)
cards.summary: Free: current conditions + toggles. Premium (~€2–3/mo, Stripe): timeline, heatmap, bio-cal, notifications, multi-location. Gated on real users existing.
cards.done: Checkout → entitlement → gated features unlock; cancel flow works.

cards.title: Open-Meteo commercial license
cards.summary: Free tier is non-commercial (~10k calls/day). First paying customer triggers the ~€29/mo API plan. Cost model: ≤2k users ≈ €0.015/user/mo data cost.

cards.title: Heat-warning notifications
cards.summary: Push when tomorrow's True Feel crosses a personal threshold. Needs PWA push or native wrapper; premium candidate.

cards.title: Deploy realtemp-api + bind D1/KV
cards.summary: Jason: wrangler d1 create + kv create + paste ids into wrangler.jsonc + wrangler deploy + set VITE_API_BASE. ~10 min.

cards.title: Enable LLM copy (secret)
cards.summary: Jason: wrangler secret put ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Cost ≈ €0.006/user/mo cached.

shipped.title: Formula module — computeTrueFeel()
shipped.summary: Steadman AT (dew-point vapor pressure) + zenith-weighted solar premium + env/activity deltas + sweat efficiency. Pure fn, all coefficients in constants.ts.
shipped.done: Unit tests pass against hand-computed fixtures incl. night (solar=0), high dew point, windy cases.
shipped.closes: closes P0-1, P0-2 (unimplementable formula, no reference model)

shipped.title: Open-Meteo adapter (Zod boundary)
shipped.summary: One call: temperature_2m, dew_point_2m, wind_speed_10m (request m/s, scale ×0.6 street), uv_index. Errors as values.
shipped.done: Valid payload parses; missing field degrades that premium, never NaN; fetch failure surfaces retry state.

shipped.title: Location: geolocation + city search
shipped.summary: Browser geolocation with Open-Meteo geocoding search fallback; last location persisted locally.
shipped.done: Denied-permission path lands on search; picked city fetches correctly.

shipped.title: Hero dashboard + transparent math breakdown
shipped.summary: True Feel dominant; each premium a signed line (base + sun + humidity − wind + urban = X°). The product's whole differentiator.
shipped.done: Breakdown always sums exactly to displayed True Feel; degraded fields hidden with badge.

shipped.title: Microclimate toggles (Exposure/Environment/Activity)
shipped.summary: Three segmented controls, instant recalc, persisted to localStorage.
shipped.done: Every combination recalculates <16ms and updates the breakdown lines.

shipped.title: Sweat Efficiency widget
shipped.summary: 0–100% evaporative-cooling gauge from dew point (100% ≤10°C → 0% ≥26°C).
shipped.done: Renders with label + value; color not the only encoding (a11y).

shipped.title: Scaffold: Vite + React + TS strict + Vitest + ESLint
shipped.summary: git init, first commit with planning docs + rockmap.

shipped.title: Degraded & error states
shipped.summary: Night zenith → solar 0; stale data badge; offline/fetch-fail with retry; never NaN on screen.
shipped.done: Each state reproducible via test and visible in UI.

shipped.title: Visual pass from Mobbin moodboard
shipped.summary: Type scale, palette, spacing tokens per moodboard; dense one-screen layout, no scroll.
shipped.done: Matches moodboard direction; WCAG AA contrast.

shipped.title: PWA manifest + icon
shipped.summary: Installable to home screen for street use; no offline cache yet.

shipped.title: iOS shell (Capacitor)
shipped.summary: Capacitor 8 SPM shell around the React app. Simulator build green, app boots and renders on iPhone 16 Pro sim. Location permission string set.

shipped.title: °F toggle
shipped.summary: Unit toggle on the hero — tap °C/°F. Deltas scale ×1.8 (no offset), absolutes convert fully. Persisted.

shipped.title: Refresh cadence + caching
shipped.summary: Refetch on focus, 10-min TTL, stale badge past TTL. Closes audit-2 gap (cadence unspecified).

shipped.title: Cold-weather term (wind chill)
shipped.summary: JAG/TI wind chill below 10°C; blend zone 10–15°C so the formula is continuous.

shipped.title: Hourly Safe Window timeline
shipped.summary: 24h graph of True Feel vs base air temp with comfort windows highlighted; same formula over hourly forecast. Promoted from PARKED.
shipped.done: Toggles apply across all 24 hours; windows visibly bounded.

shipped.title: Crash boundary (error tracking, local half)
shipped.summary: React ErrorBoundary — render crash shows a recoverable screen, never white. Trace to console until a vendor DSN exists.

shipped.title: Acclimatization Matrix + Weather Shock
shipped.summary: Rolling 14-day local baseline shifts perceived severity; spike delta flags Weather Shock. Local-only history keeps it GDPR-free.

shipped.title: Bio-calibration (height/weight/metabolic) + Clo profiles
shipped.summary: Height/weight/metabolism/clothing — bounded thermal-sign heuristic, on-device only, zero-effect defaults. Model in DECISIONS.md.

shipped.title: Crowdsourced micro-reports — code complete
shipped.summary: Worker API (D1, 1km cells, 10-min IP rate limit, 3h summary) + one-tap client UI, config-gated by VITE_API_BASE. Local-verified via wrangler dev.
shipped.done: Reports adjust local bias term; validation dashboard shows drift.

shipped.title: LLM weather copy — code complete
shipped.summary: Haiku via Worker proxy, KV location-hour cache, graceful 503 without key; client line hides when absent.

shipped.title: Sentry seam — DSN-gated, zero-cost when unset
shipped.summary: Sentry (or equivalent) — needs Jason to create the account/DSN. Boundary hook point is ready in ErrorBoundary.componentDidCatch.
